Facts:
Jean and Adriana Dubois (hereinafter the Debtors) filed for bankruptcy on July 4 2024. The value of the wifi-enabled video doorbell with motion detection owned by the Debtors has been calculated to be $175.00. Records show that Jean and Adriana possess a bamboo room divider with three folding panels with a value of $230.00. A midnight silver metallic 2025 Tesla Model Y Long Range with 2,300 miles worth $54,990.00 and a single-story farmhouse primary residence with septic and well systems appraised at $180,150.00 are both owned by Jean and Adriana Dubois.
